add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf__v2.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to PDF
add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, attach a JavaScript action that runs when the document is opened, and save the updated file.

add-multiple-javascript-actions-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple JavaScript Actions to PDF
add-multiple-javascript-actions-to-pdf.description: Shows how to combine several JavaScript statements into a single OpenAction for a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified file.

add-clickable-rectangle-with-javascript-.title: Add Clickable Rectangle with JavaScript Alert to PDF
add-clickable-rectangle-with-javascript-.description: Loads a PDF, draws a visible rectangle on the first page, and attaches a JavaScript action that shows an alert when the rectangle is clicked, then saves the result.

draw-polygon-add-javascript-link.title: Draw Polygon and Attach JavaScript Link in PDF
draw-polygon-add-javascript-link.description: Loads an existing PDF, draws a blue polygon using the low‑level Graph API, and adds a clickable area that runs JavaScript to set a variable, then saves the result.

add-javascript-open-actions-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Open Actions to PDF Document and Pages
add-javascript-open-actions-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding a document‑level JavaScript action that runs on opening the file, attaching page‑level JavaScript actions for each page, and saving the modified document.

add-rectangle-and-js-submit-link-to-pdf.title: Add Rectangle and JavaScript Submit Link to PDF
add-rectangle-and-js-submit-link-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, draws a visible black rectangle on page two using a SquareAnnotation, overlays a JavaScript link that submits form data to a URL, and saves the modified document.

add-javascript-linked-rectangles-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript-Linked Rectangles to PDF using PdfContentEditor
add-javascript-linked-rectangles-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, draw visible rectangles on specific pages, attach JavaScript actions to those rectangles with PdfContentEditor, and save the modified document.

draw-rectangle-add-javascript-mailto-lin.title: Draw Rectangle and Add JavaScript Mailto Link to PDF
draw-rectangle-add-javascript-mailto-lin.description: Loads an existing PDF, draws a rectangular annotation on the first page, attaches a JavaScript action that opens a mailto URL when clicked, and saves the modified document.

add-rectangle-with-javascript-action.title: Add Rectangle with JavaScript Action to PDF
add-rectangle-with-javascript-action.description: Shows how to load a PDF, draw a styled rectangle on a page, attach a JavaScript link to the same area using PdfContentEditor, and save the modified document.

add-javascript-action-on-pdf-page-open.title: Add JavaScript Action on PDF Page Open
add-javascript-action-on-pdf-page-open.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, attaching a JavaScript alert to each page's Open action, and saving the document using PdfContentEditor to preserve the actions.
